description: Architecture studio in Brașov, Romania: energy-efficient and passive houses, timber homes, interiors and offices. We coordinate every discipline, from planning approval to the building site.

hero.title: We calculate every detail, so you feel at home.
hero.lede: Architecture, planning and the coordination of every engineering discipline. Technical rigour in the design, and care for the people who will live in it.

footerCta: Tell us how you want to live. We'll take care of the rest.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: Our office is in central Brașov. We work in English and guide you through the whole Romanian process: checking the land, the zoning certificate (certificat de urbanism), the building permit and support during construction. Please book a meeting in advance, so we have time for your project.

manifesto.label: What we do
manifesto.text: We are an architecture studio specialising in [energy-efficient homes](/en/projects/?categorie=constructii-eficiente-energetic), [comfortable interiors](/en/projects/?categorie=amenajari-interioare) and [modern offices](/en/projects/?categorie=spatii-comerciale). We use BIM through every phase of a project, so that architecture, structure and building services fit together precisely.
